notes: Illustrative layout snapshot for the documentation example. Bounding boxes are computed from the textual reference description rather than from a real engine run; numbers in mm reflect intent, not measured output. Revision-002 lifts the three summary rows out of the LineItems table footer into a dedicated Summary region; the table now ends after its data rows and Summary appears between LineItems and Footer. Once snapshot extraction is wired into the render-runner, this file will be regenerated from the real layout engine and the notes field will be removed.

regions.name: Header
regions.children: Two equal sections: HeaderLeft (logo + company name + muted address) and HeaderRight (INVOICE title + invoice number + issue date).

regions.name: Hero
regions.children: Two-column row: TotalDue (TOTAL DUE label + large amount $ 4,820.00) and DueBy (DUE BY label + 2026-06-11).

regions.name: Parties
regions.children: Two equal sections. BillTo renders the recipient contact block. From renders the company contact block. Both columns use the shared renderContactBlock helper.

regions.name: Summary
regions.notes: Right-aligned section that mirrors the LineItems column proportions (50/10/20/20) so its right edge matches the Amount column. Width equals Unit Price + Amount (40% of content width = 70 mm); height equals three rows of body text.

regions.name: Footer
regions.children: Payment instructions paragraph, IBAN/SWIFT monospace line, faint divider, contact line in muted text.
